In [[3671 BBY]], during the [[Great Galactic War]], [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] under the employ of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] constructed a '''high-powered planetary shield''' on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]]. This shield became the primary focus of the [[Battle of Bothawui (Second; Great Galactic War)|second Battle of Bothawui]] in that year, as the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] sought to destroy the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] so that it might [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|bombard]] the planet from [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]].
